The expense policy. A receipt is required for any claim over £25; a bank or card statement is not a receipt, and a mileage log is the receipt for mileage. A claim for an expense more than 90 days old is refused. Refusal comes first: a claim that fails the receipt or age rule is refused even where it would also have gone to finance. Everything else is approved.
